moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Launch Show
moments.blurb: The glitz and glamour of Strictly Come Dancing returns to our screens tonight with the launch show for its new series, unveiling the celebrity and professional pairings.

angles.name: Launch Night Excitement
angles.copy: Sequins at the ready! Strictly Come Dancing is back tonight with its launch show. Who are you most excited to see paired up?

angles.name: New Series Buzz
angles.copy: Let the dancing commence! It's Strictly launch night, introducing the new celebrities and their pro partners. Who's your early favourite for the Glitterball?

moments.title: Premier League Matchweek 5 Continues
moments.blurb: The Premier League 2026/27 season continues with Matchweek 5 fixtures across Saturday and Sunday, before an international break begins.

angles.name: Weekend Football
angles.copy: Football's back! Matchweek 5 of the Premier League is in full swing today and tomorrow. Who are you backing for a big win?

angles.name: Sunday Showdown
angles.copy: Sunday football fix! Grab the snacks, it's a huge day in the Premier League. What's your match of the day before the international break?

moments.title: Nile Rodgers turns 74
moments.blurb: Iconic guitarist, songwriter, and producer Nile Rodgers, known for his work with Chic, David Bowie, and Daft Punk, celebrates his 74th birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating Funk Legend
angles.copy: Happy 74th birthday to the legendary Nile Rodgers! From Chic to Daft Punk, his guitar defined eras. What's your favourite track he worked on?

angles.name: Disco King
angles.copy: Celebrating the genius of Nile Rodgers today as he turns 74! A true pioneer of funk, disco, and pop. Let's get his tunes on repeat!

moments.title: Jarvis Cocker turns 63
moments.blurb: Jarvis Cocker, the distinctive frontman of Britpop band Pulp, celebrates his 63rd birthday today.

angles.name: Britpop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 63rd birthday to the one and only Jarvis Cocker! Pulp's legendary frontman still captivating. What's your favourite Pulp anthem?

angles.name: Common People Love
angles.copy: Celebrating Jarvis Cocker's 63rd today! A true icon of British music. Time to blast some Pulp!

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart Number 1
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending September 25, 2026, has just been announced, with Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' claiming the number one spot.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: It's official! Huge congrats to Sienna Spiro on topping the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Great Expectation'! What a track!

angles.name: New Number One
angles.copy: 'Great Expectation' by Sienna Spiro is your new UK number one! Are you loving the sound of the latest chart-topper?

moments.title: Chuck Panozzo turns 78
moments.blurb: Chuck Panozzo, co-founder and bassist of the legendary rock band Styx, celebrates his 78th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Styx Legend
angles.copy: Happy 78th birthday for tomorrow to Chuck Panozzo, the incredible bassist and co-founder of Styx! What's your favourite Styx classic?

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we celebrate Chuck Panozzo turning 78! Raise a glass to the rock legend behind some of Styx's biggest hits.

moments.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
moments.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday for Monday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still rocking harder than anyone. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

angles.name: Mad Fer It
angles.copy: Be here now! Liam Gallagher turns 54 on Monday. Get ready for some serious rock 'n' roll anthems to celebrate!

moments.title: Joan Jett turns 68
moments.blurb: Rock legend Joan Jett, known for hits like 'I Love Rock 'n' Roll' and her work with The Runaways, turns 68 on Tuesday.

angles.name: Queen of Rock 'n' Roll
angles.copy: She loves rock 'n' roll! Happy 68th birthday to the incredible Joan Jett on Tuesday! What's your favourite track from the rock icon?

angles.name: Bad Reputation
angles.copy: Celebrating the punk rock queen, Joan Jett, who turns 68 on Tuesday! Still an absolute trailblazer.

moments.title: Autumnal Equinox
moments.blurb: The Autumnal Equinox officially marks the start of astronomical autumn in the UK, occurring in the early hours of Wednesday, September 23, bringing nearly equal day and night.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: Goodbye summer, hello autumn! Wednesday is the Autumnal Equinox, meaning officially it's the first day of astronomical autumn. Time for cosy jumpers and pumpkin spice?

angles.name: Equal Day, Equal Night
angles.copy: Equal day, equal night! The Autumnal Equinox is here early Wednesday morning. What's your favourite thing about the start of autumn?

moments.title: Bruce Springsteen turns 77
moments.blurb: The Boss himself, legendary American singer-songwriter Bruce Springsteen, celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Boss
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday on Wednesday to the one and only Boss, Bruce Springsteen! What's your all-time favourite Springsteen anthem?

angles.name: Born To Run
angles.copy: Born to Run! Celebrating Bruce Springsteen's 77th birthday this Wednesday. His music still sounds as epic as ever.

moments.title: Cedric Dent turns 64
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning vocalist and arranger Cedric Dent, best known as a long-standing member of the acapella gospel/R&B group Take 6, turns 64 on Thursday.

angles.name: Take 6 Vocalist
angles.copy: Happy 64th birthday on Thursday to Cedric Dent, the incredible vocalist from the legendary group Take 6! Pure vocal harmony.

angles.name: R&B/Gospel Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Cedric Dent's 64th birthday this Thursday! A true master of vocal arrangements and a key part of Take 6's success.

moments.title: Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix
moments.blurb: The Formula 1 season continues this weekend with the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, featuring practice and qualifying on Friday and Saturday, leading up to the main race on Sunday.

angles.name: F1 Race Weekend
angles.copy: It's F1 race weekend! The Azerbaijan Grand Prix kicks off with practice and qualifying today and tomorrow. Who's your pick for pole position?

angles.name: Street Circuit Thrills
angles.copy: Get ready for some street circuit thrills! The Azerbaijan Grand Prix is on. Will we see any surprises on this challenging track?

moments.title: Will Smith turns 58
moments.blurb: Actor and Grammy-winning rapper Will Smith, famous for hits like 'Gettin' Jiggy wit It' and his Fresh Prince days, turns 58 on Friday.

angles.name: Fresh Prince Day
angles.copy: Yo, Home to Bel-Air! Happy 58th birthday to Will Smith this Friday! What's your favourite track or movie moment from the legend?

angles.name: Gettin' Jiggy
angles.copy: Gettin' Jiggy wit It! Celebrating Will Smith's 58th birthday on Friday. From Fresh Prince to global superstar, he's done it all.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing First Live Show
moments.blurb: The Strictly Come Dancing couples take to the dancefloor for the very first time in the competitive live show this Saturday, vying for the judges' scores.

angles.name: Live Show Excitement
angles.copy: The competition officially begins! Strictly Come Dancing has its first live show this Saturday. Who do you think will impress the judges?

angles.name: Dance Floor Debut
angles.copy: It's time for the first dances! The Strictly couples make their debut on the live show this Saturday. Get ready for some sparkle and scores!

moments.title: Bryan Ferry turns 81
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter Bryan Ferry, known for his distinctive vocal style and as the frontman of Roxy Music, celebrates his 81st birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: Roxy Music Icon
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday this Saturday to the effortlessly cool Bryan Ferry! The iconic voice of Roxy Music. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Timeless Style
angles.copy: Celebrating Bryan Ferry's 81st birthday this Saturday! A true legend whose music transcends generations. Pour yourself a sophisticated drink!

moments.title: Avril Lavigne turns 42
moments.blurb: Pop-punk princess Avril Lavigne, known for anthems like 'Complicated' and 'Sk8er Boi', turns 42 on Sunday.

angles.name: Pop-Punk Queen
angles.copy: Why'd you have to go and make things so complicated? Happy 42nd birthday to Avril Lavigne this Sunday! Still an icon.

angles.name: Sk8er Boi
angles.copy: Sk8er Boi turns 42! Celebrating Avril Lavigne's birthday on Sunday. What's your go-to track from the pop-punk queen?

moments.title: Lil Wayne turns 38
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning American rapper Lil Wayne, one of the most influential hip-hop artists of his generation, celebrates his 38th birthday on Sunday.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 38th birthday to the legendary Lil Wayne this Sunday! Drop your favourite Weezy track to celebrate!

angles.name: Young Money
angles.copy: Celebrating Lil Wayne's 38th birthday on Sunday! From 'Tha Block Is Hot' to global superstar, he's a true game-changer.

moments.title: Hilary Duff turns 39
moments.blurb: Actress and singer Hilary Duff, known for her roles in 'Lizzie McGuire' and hits like 'Come Clean', celebrates her 39th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Lizzie McGuire Star
angles.copy: Happy 39th birthday on Monday to the wonderful Hilary Duff! From teen idol to pop star, she's done it all. What's your favourite Hilary hit?

angles.name: Come Clean
angles.copy: Celebrating Hilary Duff's 39th birthday this Monday! Let's throw it back to her iconic early 00s bops.

moments.title: Halsey turns 32
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Halsey, known for their genre-bending hits and powerful vocals, turns 32 on Tuesday.

angles.name: Modern Pop Force
angles.copy: Happy 32nd birthday to the incredible Halsey on Tuesday! Their music always hits different. What's your favourite Halsey track?

angles.name: Without Me
angles.copy: Celebrating Halsey's birthday this Tuesday! From 'Closer' to 'Without Me', a true modern pop force.
